overview.title: The Flame and the Wok
overview.text:
Authentic Chinese cuisine is a masterclass in fire control (Wok Hei) and precise choping. In Dhaka, Chinese food has evolved, but the demand for authentic, high-fidelity Cantonese and Szechuan cooking remains extremely strong for restaurant-tier chefs.

CIB's Chinese Cooking Course teaches you the technical rules of high-heat cooking. You will learn to control wok fire, execute traditional dim sum folding, and draft complex Chinese stocks and sauces.

highlights.title: Wok Hei Mastery
highlights.description: Learn flame management and tossing for authentic wok breath.

highlights.title: Dim Sum Folding
highlights.description: Master dumpling dough prep and intricate folding techniques.

highlights.title: Mother Sauces
highlights.description: Prepare Szechuan, Kung Pao, Sweet & Sour, and Black Bean bases.

highlights.title: Texture Control
highlights.description: Understand velvetting meat and crisp vegetable blanching.

features: Mastering high-heat wok tossing and flame safety protocols
Folding dim sums, momos, and traditional spring rolls
Preparing clear broths and traditional Chinese chicken stocks
Velvetting chicken and beef for soft, restaurant-grade texture
Making custom chili oil, Szechuan paste, and sweet soy reduction
Accredited specialty certificate in Chinese Gastronomy

faqs.question: What dishes are taught in this course?
faqs.answer: We cover Dim Sum/Dumplings, Kung Pao Chicken, Beef with Black Bean Sauce, Szechuan Fried Rice, Hakka Noodles, and Hot & Sour Soup.

faqs.question: Is this the same as local Bangla-Chinese cooking?
faqs.answer: No. While we briefly explain the history of Chinese-Bangla adaptation, this course focuses primarily on authentic Szechuan and Cantonese techniques.
